reasoning_content:
Node installed, but the binary lives in fnm's node-versions dir. Let me find the node path and make it persistent. Actually for running npm install etc., I can eval fnm env each time. But for bin/rails shims to work later, node isn't needed at runtime necessarily. Let me set up env in a helper.

Let me find node location.

action.command: export PATH=/usr/local/fnm:$PATH; eval "$(fnm env)"; echo "PATH=$PATH"; ls /root/.local/share/fnm/node-versions 2>/dev/null; which node npm

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "export PATH=/usr/local/fnm:$PATH; eval \"$(fnm env)\"; echo \"PATH=$PATH\"; ls /root/.local/share/fnm/node-versions 2>/dev/null; which node npm", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Locate node install path"}
